basic_info.description: Captivating Potrero Hill retreat with sweeping city views and enchanting outdoor space! Behind its cheerful blue faade, a dramatic living room presents soaring ceilings, bamboo floors, exposed beams, and a wall of French doors framing views west across the city. The open dining/living area flows to the chef's kitchen, equipped with a polished concrete island, butcher block counters, Viking range, custom cabinetry, and built-in dining banquette. French doors open directly to a lush 3-tiered garden with a lemon tree and koi pond. The magical garden is an entertainer's dream with a dining patio with built-in heaters, and string lights overhead. The main level hosts a guest suite with Murphy bed, French doors to the garden patio, and an ensuite bath with shower. The lower-level primary suite features a spacious bedroom oriented toward the views, a large walk-in closet, and a luxurious ensuite bath with double sinks and a walk-in shower. Completing this level is a laundry room and a sunroom with a glass door that opens to the garden, an ideal office/gym/nursery. 1-car garage plus front parking. Perched on the western slope of Potrero Hill, this location offers plenty of lovely green spaces nearby, plus shops and restaurants on 18th St. and 24th St.
